channel.title: The Bedford Town Briefing
channel.description: A daily insider briefing on Bedford Town FC and the National League North -- team news, the wider divisional picture, and what's moving in the tiers above and below. Built for the people who run the club.
channel.itunes:author: The Bedford Town Briefing

item.title: Ep 1 — Away at Spalding United
item.description: Bedford Town go to Spalding on the back of three straight wins, with a fresh Law change on delayed restarts now in effect and Real Bedford setting the pace two divisions down. Team news, the wider National League North picture, and what's moving at Step One and Step Three.
